shared_or_similar_visual_information: A right-pointing arrowhead at the far end of a horizontal coordinate axis.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It indicates the positive x direction and continuation of the coordinate axis. Right image: It indicates the positive x direction and continuation of the coordinate axis.
Rationales: Both arrowheads are attached to the positive end of an x-axis and indicate its positive direction and continuation. A quadrilateral drawing and a unit-circle diagram use that same coordinate convention.
